name: Goshogawara (Japan)
description: A yellow field charged at the centre with the Goshogawara city emblem in blue, green and red: a blue stylised letter G with a green stroke and a red disc.
history: Municipal flag of Goshogawara, a city in Aomori Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 July 2005.

features.role: Goshogawara city emblem — a blue stylised letter G with a green stroke and a red disc
